newsitem.title: USA: ONBANCorp to buyback up to 10 pct of shrs.
newsitem.headline: ONBANCorp to buyback up to 10 pct of shrs.

text.p: ONBANCorp Inc said Thursday it authorized the repurchase of up to 1,400,000 shares of its common stock from time to time in either open market or privately negotiated transactions.
ONBANCorp said it currently had 13,951,246 shares of common stock outstanding. The company said the repurchase adds up to 10 percent of its common shares.

ONBANCorp Inc also said its subsidiary OnBank Capital Trust I has completed a private placement of $60 million 9.25 percent Capital Securities due Feb. 1, 2027 underwritten by Keefe Bruyette & Woods Inc, Sandler O'Neil & Partners LP and Blaylock & Partners LP.
The Capital Securities are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by ONBANCorp, the company said.
